items.definition:
surprisingly
He didn't even say goodbye.

in whatever way; nevertheless
It was raining; however, we still went for a walk.

actually
I actually forgot my keys.

to a certain extent; somewhat
It's rather cold today.

more, additionally
We need to discuss this further.

fairly, completely
It's quite cold outside today.

as an alternative
I don't want coffee; I'll have tea instead.

especially
I like all fruits, especially apples.

probably
It's likely to rain later today.

towards the front
Please step forward.

perhaps
Perhaps we should go home now.

currently
He is currently working on a new project.

not long ago
I recently visited Paris.

totally
I completely forgot about the meeting.

almost
It's nearly midnight.

completely; totally
I absolutely agree with you.

at once; instantly
Please come here immediately.

without any doubt
I will definitely be there.

generally
Generally, I prefer to work in the morning.

anymore
I don't live there anymore.

in a serious manner; very much
He took the criticism seriously.

in any case; regardless
It was raining, but we went out anyway.

in a direct manner; without delay or interruption
Please send the email directly to him.

completely, entirely
I fully understand your point.

in the end, especially after a long delay
Eventually, he found the keys he was looking for.

in circumstances different from those present or implied
You should study hard; otherwise, you might fail the exam.

for that reason; consequently
He was tired; therefore, he went to bed early.

in a truthful way; genuinely
I truly appreciate your help.

for the most part; mainly
The weather was mostly sunny today.

at a previous time; before now.
She had previously worked as a teacher.

completely; absolutely.
I totally agree with you.

in a way that is easily perceived or understood; clearly
Obviously, you need to study more for the exam.

extremely
The weather was extremely cold.

possibly
It's possibly the best movie I've ever seen.

to a small degree; a little
She was slightly taller than her brother.

for all time; for always
I will love you forever.

in an honest way
Honestly, I don't know the answer.

correctly or appropriately
Make sure you close the door properly.

in the most essential respects; fundamentally
Basically, the plan is to save money.

usually; in a typical way
She typically arrives at work around 9 AM.

sadly; regrettably
Unfortunately, we ran out of tickets.

in a perfect manner; completely
The plan worked perfectly.

mostly; chiefly
The audience was mainly composed of students.

usually; in normal circumstances
I normally wake up at 7 AM.

in a personal capacity; by way of personal involvement or opinion
Personally, I think it's a great idea.

with hope
Hopefully, the weather will be good tomorrow.

certainly; without doubt
Surely you're not going out in this rain?

to a great degree; with great weight
It was raining heavily.

by a large number of people or in many places
The news was widely reported.

throughout the world
The product is sold worldwide.

in a close manner; with little space or time between
They worked closely together on the project.

all the time; continuously
He is constantly checking his phone.

almost not; barely
I could hardly hear what he was saying.

in a way that is not known or specified; by some means
We'll manage to finish the project somehow.

without human intervention; by itself
The door opens automatically when you approach it.

to a moderate extent; justly
She sings fairly well.

almost not, hardly
She could barely hear him over the noise.

at the same time
The train was delayed; meanwhile, we waited at the station.

in a natural way; as expected
She naturally excels at sports.

in a short time; soon
The train will arrive shortly.

with great physical power or force; in a strong manner
She strongly believes in equal rights for everyone.

in, at, or to some other place
He decided to look for work elsewhere.

successfully
She successfully completed the difficult task.

deeply
She was deeply moved by the story.
